entities.name: Ozolith
entities.description: A field of crystal formations on Ikoria, far north of Drannith, manipulated to influence the plane's monsters.

entities.name: Argalith
entities.description: Crystal at the center of Drannith's defenses.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: Planeswalker who noticed the mutations among Ikoria's fauna.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: Monster bonder who learned to control mutated monsters through the Ozolith.

events.summary: Vivien notices mutations and new bonds between men and monsters and fears an unnamed planeswalker's doing.
events.quote: Vivien feared that this was all an unnamed planeswalker's doing.

events.summary: Vivien and Lukka trace the changes to the Ozolith, where Lukka learns he can control the mutated monsters.
events.quote: Lukka realized he was able to control the mutated monsters

events.summary: When Drannith refuses his help, Lukka attacks the city with his monsters.
events.quote: Lukka attacked the city with his monsters himself

events.summary: Lukka uses too much power, overloading and shattering the Ozolith.
events.quote: The Ozolith was overloaded and shattered.

relations.quote: Vivien and Lukka tracked the source of these changes to the Ozolith
